description: Encrypt a PDF with AES-256 so it cannot be opened without the password. Use this before sending a document that contains anything private. The input is uploaded to the Papyrio API, processed in memory and not stored. The result is written to output_path, replacing any file already there, and the call returns that path and the size in bytes. Inputs are limited to 50 MB, and each call counts as one operation against the daily quota.

file.description: Absolute path to the PDF to encrypt.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the result to. Defaults to the input file with a "-papyrio.pdf" suffix.

password.description: Password that will be required to open the resulting PDF.

name: protect_pdf
